title: 第十章 她不是你们可以欺负的人
slug: 和情敌共感后傲娇竹马火葬场了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

可是，夏暮却没有再为他停下脚步。

她垂敛视线，长睫微颤，连眼神都没有多给薄璟琛一个，径直从他身侧走过。

肩膀擦过他的上臂，残留一阵诱人的苦橘香气。

薄璟琛的喉结，微不可察地滚了一下。

但他没有回头，而是迈步走进会议室。

那几个女同事还没来得及松一口气，就撞上薄璟琛冷得像淬了冰的眼神。

“你们几个，去人事部办离职，现在。”

“小薄总......”几个女人本就难看的脸色，此时更是“唰”地翻白，再无半点血色。

薄璟琛只是微微偏头。

狭长的眼尾扫过去，带着漫不经心，“认清自己的位置，她不是你们可以欺负的人。”

夏暮回到工位的时候，整个办公区的气氛已经变得微妙起来。

有人偷偷拿眼瞄她，有人假装埋头工作竖着耳朵听动静。

微信小群已经炸了锅，她刚才瞥见了。

她一概当作看不见，蹲下身，把脚边的纸箱拖出来，开始收拾东西。

东西不算多。

她在这间公司待了三年，真正属于她的东西，一个纸箱都装不满。

她把东西一样一样放进纸箱里。

桌面的收拾完，她拉开抽屉，

手指触到了一个冰凉的相框。

动作，短暂地顿住了。

那是她刻意塞进抽屉最深处的。

照片上，十七岁的她和十九岁的薄璟琛并肩站在薄家老宅的银杏树下。

秋天的银杏叶落了满地金黄，她踮着脚尖，往他头发上插了一片叶子，笑得眉眼弯弯。

那时候的薄璟琛还没有现在这么凌厉。

少年人的下颌线还没有长出刀锋般的弧度，他被她捉弄了，佯装生气地皱起眉，唇角却是压不住的上扬。

那是他还会对她笑的年纪。

夏暮盯着照片看了很久。

那时候，薄璟琛是真的对她很好。

她被接进薄家的时候才六岁，父母刚走，每天晚上都躲在被子里哭。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

However, Xia Mu did not stop for him.

She lowered her gaze, her long eyelashes trembling slightly, and walked straight past him without even looking at Bo Jingchen.

The shoulder brushed against his upper arm, leaving an alluring aroma of bitter orange.

Bo Jingchen's Adam's apple rolled imperceptibly.

But he didn't look back and walked into the conference room.

Before those female colleagues had time to breathe a sigh of relief, they met Bo Jingchen's eyes that were as cold as ice.

"You guys, go to the personnel department to apply for resignation now."

"Mr. Xiao Bo..." The ugly faces of several women turned pale at this time, without any color at all.

Bo Jingchen just tilted his head slightly.

The tail of his narrow eyes swept over, and he said casually, "Recognize your position, she is not someone you can bully."

When Xia Mu returned to her work station, the atmosphere in the entire office area had become subtle.

Some people glanced at her secretly, while others pretended to be immersed in their work and listened carefully.

The WeChat group has exploded, she just caught a glimpse of it.

She pretended she couldn't see it, squatted down, pulled out the cardboard box at her feet, and started packing her things.

Not much stuff.

She has been in this company for three years, and not even a single cardboard box can hold anything that truly belongs to her.

She put everything into the cardboard box one by one.

After clearing the desktop, she opened the drawer,

His fingers touched a cold photo frame.

The movement paused briefly.

That was what she deliberately stuffed into the deepest part of the drawer.

In the photo, the 17-year-old she and the 19-year-old Bo Jingchen stood side by side under the ginkgo tree in the Bo family's old house.

The ginkgo leaves in autumn fell golden all over the ground. She stood on tiptoes and inserted a leaf into his hair, smiling with crooked eyebrows.

At that time, Bo Jingchen was not as fierce as he is now.

The young man's jawline had not yet grown into a razor-like curve. He was teased by her, and he frowned in pretending to be angry, but the corners of his lips couldn't help but rise.

That was the age when he would still smile at her.

Xia Mu stared at the photo for a long time.

At that time, Bo Jingchen was really kind to her.

She was only six years old when she was taken into the Bo family. Her parents had just left, and she hid in the quilt and cried every night.
